environment: **Trusted repo**: ~/portfolio — a personal Astro 7 portfolio/blog site, not a git repository (no version control, no remotes, so edits are not recoverable via git)
**Project tooling**: npm scripts (`dev`, `build`, `preview`) wrapping the Astro CLI; prettier runs automatically after file edits via a PostToolUse hook
Routine edits under src/, public/, and the Astro config are expected, low-risk personal site development
